data.name: Tarkeshwar
data.gender_notes: Tarkeshwar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Tarkeshwar is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Tarka’ meaning Crossroads and ‘Ishwar’ meaning God or Lord. The name Tarkeshwar signifies the one who is the Lord of the Crossroads, and is considered to be a powerful and strong deity in Hindu mythology. The name Tarkeshwar carries the meaning “Lord of the Crossroads” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Tarkeshwar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the crossroads and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power to make decisions at the crossroads of life.
data.etymology: Tarkeshwar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Crossroads.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tarkeshwar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tarkeshwar is deeply rooted in Hindu culture, particularly in the folklore of North India. Temples dedicated to Tarkeshwar are found in various regions, most notably in Uttarakhand and Maharashtra. Tarkeshwar is believed to offer protection and guidance to travelers at crossroads, particularly in difficult and uncertain times.
data.spiritual_significance: For Hindus, Tarkeshwar is a symbol of the divine presence and guidance at the critical junctures of life. The name embodies the idea that the Lord is always with us, even at the most challenging and uncertain times. Tarkeshwar is also considered to be a powerful healer, capable of curing both physical and spiritual ailments. Thus, the name holds deep spiritual significance for Hindus, representing the idea of divine protection, guidance, and healing.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Tarkeshwar, meaning 'Lord of the Chariot', symbolizes the journey of the soul towards self-realization. As the charioteer, Lord Shiva guides the devotee, steering them through life's challenges and towards spiritual enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Tarkeshwar Mahadev is a temple located in the Garhwal Himalayas in Uttarakhand, India. The name Tarkeshwar carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Tarkeshwar Mahadev is a popular Hindu pilgrimage site.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Tarkeshwar remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
